name: Wanees's Diaries
description: Wanees and Maysa are proud parents who want what's best for their four children. They teach them what's right and wrong, and discover that they are also learning new things.

credits_cast.character: Wanees ونيس أبو الفضل جاد الله عويس عبدالحق
credits_cast.name: Mohamed Sobhi

credits_cast.character: Abu Al Fadl Jadallah Ewees Abdulhaq أبو الفضل
credits_cast.name: Gamil Ratib

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Wanis asks Maysa to cook the duck that he just bought. When the children ask him to go to a pizza parlor for ice cream, Ezzeldin ends up costing Wanis a lot of money after he order pizza. To prevent the mango from being spoiled, Wanis resolves to eat it before it goes bad.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Fou'ad lies to the CEO and asks Wanis to cover for him, but Wanis refuses to. Sharaffudin breaks a glass display in a store, prompting the owner to take his watch as compensation. Sharaffudin tries to hide what happened by claiming that a thief stole his watch, but the store owner exposes his lie.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Zeinat borrows Maysa's china to keep up appearances in front of her daughter's suitor. Abla asks Wanis to lend her their dinner table as well, which angers Sharaffudin who is expecting his private tutor. Wanis exposes Khalil in front of Fou'ad, who turns out to be putting up a false facade as well.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Fou'ad buys a used car that turns out to be faulty. When he fails in returning it, he decides to sell it to Wanis, who finds out about its defectiveness. As Wanis tries to give it back to the car dealership, an antique enthusiast offers to buy it for a higher price.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Maysa's friend suspects her of giving their manager false information about her in order to seize her promotion. When Wanis finds a cigarette in Ezzeldin's school book, he monitors his son until he discovers that the cigarette belongs to Khalil's son, Wa'el.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In order to accompany his siblings on a trip, Sharaffudin entrusts the dog that his friend gave him to his parents. Khalil and his wife leave the children in Maysa's care. Wanis admonishes Khalil and Zeinat for foisting off their responsibility on others, and berates Sharaffudin for doing the same.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With Ezzeldin fighting with Sharaffudin, Wanis gets fed up with his children's laziness and the fact that he and Maysa are shouldering the burden. Wanis and Maysa decide to take some time off and leave the children to work out how to work together.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: When Fou'ad is acquitted, he expresses his anger at Wanis's lack of support. Maysa brings some plants home. When the family finds the plants torn apart, Jihad pins it on Sharaffudin, but Wanis discovers that the neighbor's cat is the real culprit and gets Jihad to apologize.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl is duped into buying a cassette for an exaggerated price. Jihad invites a lot of her friends over in hopes of getting many presents. When Jihad sees Ezzeldin beating a guy at the club, she seizes the chance to extort him. Ezzeldin comes clean to Wanis about both his and Jihad's actions.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: When Ezzeldin's submission for a literary contest turns out to be plagiarized from Yusuf Idris, Abu Al-Fadl asks Ezzeldin to write an original story in three days and promises to get him pizza in return. Wanis decides to make the pizza himself, only for it to fail miserably.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Wanis asks his children to donate their old clothes to those in need, but Sharaffudin hides his clothes under the bed. Mo'taza rejects her miserly suitor. When Wanis discovers what Sharaffudin did with the clothes, he berates him.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: When Madiha invites Maysa over, the former's husband Tharwat shows off her wealth in front of Wanis and Maysa. Jihad lies to her friends about her father's job, but when the school throws a celebration in honor of Jihad's academic achievement, Wanis reveals that he is a simple employee.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: When Maysa and the children come down with the flu, Wanis is left to care for the entire family. As Tharwat and Madiha visit with them, Maysa asks Wanis to treat them well, but Madiha ends up provoking Maysa.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: When Maysa's mother faces car trouble, a good Samaritan's attempt to help only makes things worse. Maysa's mother convinces Abu Al-Fadl to partner up with her to buy chicks, but her lack of experience causes them to lose their money.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Wanis tries to alleviate his children's fears after they watch a horror movie. Wanis's mother-in-law thinks that she is being watched, but the watchers turn out to be the security detail of a government official. Wanis reassures Ezzeldin who is fearful of his wrestling opponent.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Wanis takes Maysa to a fancy restaurant where the waiter keeps advising them to change their order. Jihad finds a chocolate box in the street and takes it home. After she divides it among the family, she grows repentant and decides to borrow some money to give the chocolate back to its owner.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Wanis takes Maysa to see a new apartment, but the building collapses due to construction violations. Wanis tries to get a higher price for the tomato crops that belong to his mother-in-law, but he waits too long for a higher price, and his greed leaves the tomatoes to spoil.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: When Wanis discovers that Khalil's bathroom is dripping water into his own bathroom, he soon learns that it's a common problem in the building since all the bathrooms drip water. His attempts to find a solution fails due to the residents' lack of care and inability to work together.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The children inquire about their extended family after they see a large family at a restaurant. Wanis discovers that his relative, Zozo, has passed away, and that the woman he has been speaking to is not his relative. Nonetheless, he insists on helping her see her grandson Hossam.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Wanis is dissatisfied with the way the employees are sucking up to the CEO. As Wanis helps Mama Zozo sell her apartment, she asks him to send for her grandson, Hossam. Hossam's father plots to seize Zozo's money, but Wanis devises a plan to force him to show his true colors.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: When Wanis accidentally takes home a love letter meant for Fou'ad, Maysa suspects that Wanis is in love with his cousin, Harisa. Wanis's mother-in-law discovers that the letter was meant for Fou'ad and informs Maysa, who apologizes to Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Wanis advises Sharaffudin and Jihad to face their fears and trust in their readiness for the exams. In an attempt to get her to leave the apartment, the landlord of Maysa's mother tries to freak her out by faking weird noises. Wanis and Ezzeldin stay in the apartment and uncover the landlord's plot.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: When Maysa suspects that Khalil is cheating on Zeinat, she monitors him and drops hints for Zeinat. As Zeinat accompanies Maysa to monitor Khalil, she comes to discover that Khalil was only visiting his cousin and that Maysa's curiosity almost ruined their lives.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: When Harisa's miserliness rubs off on Wanis, he ends up fighting with Maysa for her overspending. The family suffers from Wanis's miserliness until Maysa embarrasses him by exposing his actions in front of the CEO and an American delegation.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: When Maysa gets promoted to a management position, a jealous Wanis stirs up trouble. Ezzeldin wins the championship and qualifies for a championship in Rome, which stirs up his sister's jealousy to the point where she spills ink on his passport to sabotage his trip.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jihad asks her father for money to buy a boat for her and her siblings, but she ends up spending the money on herself. When Maysa's sister sends her tickets to go to the US, and Wanis's friend gets him a job opportunity in Austria, Wanis and Maysa choose to stay with their children.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: As the family goes on vacation in Hurghada, they run into a lot of obstacles, including when Maysa's mother stubbornly refuses to follow Wanis's car and takes another road, leaving her stranded away from the rest of the family until Mama Zozo notices and directs her to the main road.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Khalil admonishes Wanis and Maysa for taking Fou'ad along on their trip. As Wanis's family clashes with their companions as to where to go, Hoda goes missing. She returns on her own and informs them that she sought another family because they were too busy thinking about themselves.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: When Hossam throws Fou'ad in the swimming pool as a joke, Fou'ad's wig comes off, which earns him a lot of ridicule. Fou'ad gets him back when he also dunks him in the swimming pool, which reveals that Hossam is also covering his baldness with a wig.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: In an attempt to stay in Hurghada a little longer, Wanis feigns illness. As the family gets lost in the desert, each member reveals a huge secret to the others. They eventually learn that they are right next to their hotel.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Wanis' children start the new school year, they ask their father for extra money for their school supplies, just like their friends. As Wanis takes them to the store to buy their supplies, he is stunned at the very high bill.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Tharwat's son gets into trouble with his classmates after he brags about his money in front of his friends, including Wanis' son, Sharaffudin. The son of the CEO of the company at which Wanis works takes over after his father travels and gets into many problems with Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Fou'ad is envious of his friends, including Wanis, for his high salary. As Jihad works with her friend Shosho in advertisements, the son of the CEO of the company at which Wanis works admires her and asks her to be the star of the company's advertisements.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ezzeldin enters into a love story with Rabha, the seller. On the other hand, Wanis notices his father's relationship with a girl named Fairouz, but Abu Al-Fadl loves Fairouz's mother, whose name is Ferdous. The principal of Ezzeldin's school discovers that he holds a love letter and summons Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wanis makes Fairouz falls in love with him after believing that his father loves her, and indeed he meets her again and again until the girl falls for him, whereupon Abu Al-Fadl discovers the matter and tells Wanis that he does not love Fairouz, but rather loves her mother Ferdous.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Maysa refuses to come to a decision in the renewal process of one of the companies that applied to her company regarding the process of fire extinguishing and alarms in the companies. Ferdous tells Abu Al-Fadl that her daughter was suffering a psychological illness and won't forget what Wanis did to her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Investigations prove Maysa’s innocence of the charge of dereliction of duty regarding the bank fire. The Administrative Prosecution also praises her behavior when she insists on training employees to deal with fires, which helped in extinguishing the bank. Abu Al-Fadl marries Ferdous.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Wanis strongly opposes the project of the son of the CEO after all the board of directors approved it. After Wanis tells Hossam that his wife Mo'taza fell down the stairs and lost the baby, he tells him that this a lie and that his wife will tell him the truth, which is that she is sterile.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Hossam provokes the son of the CEO and brings him employees in his office to tighten the screws on him so that he quit work. Tharwat offers Wanis a job in one of his companies in exchange for Wanis to take on teaching and caring of his son Imtyaz.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wanis resigns to take on his new job at Tharwat's company, only to be surprised that Tharwat has traveled to Rome. Maysa withdraws her money from the bank and gives it to Khalil as a down payment for a new apartment in the same building without telling Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Ferdous tells her husband Abu Al-Fadl that she will resort to plastic surgery and that she has agreed with a doctor to perform it on her face. Maysa hesitates to tell Wanis that she's pregnant, then she eventually decides to tell him, upon which he becomes very angry.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Ezzeldin quarrels with a child, who brings his older brother, who hits Ezzeldin severely. Fo'uad finds a job vacancy for Wanis as a manager in a hotel for dogs. Wanis takes on the job without knowing it is related to dogs and is exposed to comedic situations for his fear of dogs.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As Maysa neglects her health, Wanis asks her to take care of herself and the baby. Wanis' children leave Imtyaz at home and he goes to the police station to file a report against Wanis, but the letter that Tharwat sent with his son saves Wanis from the kidnapping charges.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: At the house, Wanis and Maysa are surprised to find a lion cub, which Sharaffudin's friend asked him to take care of. Abdullah comes and deals with the lion gently without fear, and from that time Wanis learns how to deal with the lion.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: After Wanis threatens Khalil with the lion and demands that he pay the money he took from Maysa, Khalil files a report against Wanis, claiming that he terrorizes the residents with a lion, which Wanis hides when the police arrives. Wanis files a report against Khalil for disturbing the authorities.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Wanis stands by Imtyaz after the accident he was exposed to. Maysa’s twins die while she is giving birth and Harisa gives birth to Haris. Wanis and his family grieve for the loss of his twins. Abdullah suggests that Wanis turns the room prepared for his twins into a law firm.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Tharwat returns from abroad and is surprised by his son's behavior and discipline. As Wanis' client asks him to file a case against her ex-husband, Wanis reveals the truth about a new man she's seeing. As the client admires Wanis, Maysa intervenes at the pivotal moment.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl agrees with Fairouz on a plan to divorce her mother, Ferdous, to return again to her husband, Fairouz's father, especially that Fairouz suffers from many psychological problems due to her parents' separation. Indeed, Abu Al-Fadl divorces Ferdous.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Maysa manages Wanis’ affairs in the legal profession. Among the clients, a man who believes he has children. He convinces Maysa that his children don't care about him, but Wanis comes to reveal that the old man has no children and is not even married.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Tharwat asks Wanis to file a lawsuit against the radio station, which rejected his son Imtyaz. Wanis tries to convince his son Ezzeldin to enroll in the college he wants him to join, while Maysa tries to convince him to enroll in another college that she wants Ezzeldin to join.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A new client asks Wanis to file a divorce case against her husband. When Wanis gets sick and suffers from overstress because of his continuous work, his children are forced to postpone traveling to America, as their grandmother sent them an invitation to visit her there.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Farid defrauds Tharwat after selling him a farm without registering a contract for him. He also scams Abu Al-Fadl and Khalil after he sells the same farm to both of them. Then he robs a large sum of money and leaves Khalil's daughter Abla on the wedding day and flees.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: As Maysa tries to return the favor to the woman who got her married to Wanis, she tries to wed her to Abdullah, who refuses and gets angry at her in front of everyone. After Hossam, Mama Zozo's grandson, sells her apartment behind her back and emigrates to Australia; she goes to live with Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Khalil ignores his son Wa'el when he discovers a crack in the stair wall. Hoda discovers another big crack and tells her father, Wanis, who as well doesn't pay attention. After the building collapses, Wanis goes to live with his father Abu Al-Fadl.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Wanis and his family try to adjust to their new life. The bank employees help Maysa with a sum of money after the collapse of the building in which she lived. The company where Khalil works also gives him and his family an apartment to live in instead of the apartment that collapsed.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: When Uncle Abdo needs money for treatment, Wanis and Maysa try to help. Abdullah gives the money to Wanis after he leads a man to Khalil whom he defrauded of the contract of his apartment, which collapsed in the rubble. The man gets his right from Khalil and gives a reward to Abdullah.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After Wanis turns down a job in the archives with a humble salary, he, Maysa and his family get involved with the neighborhood community. He visits his neighbors, go to Hamdi, his friend from school days, who tells him about Abdul Jalil and Master Shehata, who wants to marry one of his sisters.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: As Sharaffudin suggests on his family to sell the house they live to buy an apartment and put the rest of the money in the bank, they discover that Uncle Abdo mortgaged the house for 20,000 pounds to Master Shehata. Hossam and Mo'taza return from Australia after the bank confiscated their money.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: A broadcaster comes to Wanis' house and asks him to answer some questions to win the prize. But when he wins, Uncle Abdo ruins everything.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: As Wanis is upset that his children are neglecting their studies, he discovers they are working to collect the house mortgage. Wanis refuses that Maysa travel abroad for a large sum of money. Jihad wins first place in a literary competition, as the title of the story is "Wanis' Daily Life".

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Wanis and Maysa take their children on a trip to the zoo before the school vacation ends. Tharwat's company gets into big trouble after he travels abroad and leaves it to Wanis' responsibility.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After Wanis gathers his children, his father and his wife, he decides to clean the street from garbage, after which people make fun of him and his family, whereupon Wanis' children get angry.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As Tharwat's son comes to Wanis' house and leaves with him money and jewelry, he tells him that his father told him to keep these things with him until he returns from abroad. Ezzeldin works in a restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Lawyers withhold Tharwat's company after his big financial crises and his escape abroad. Wanis decides not to tell them about what Tharwat has entrusted to him. Ezzeldin meets a deaf-mute girl and decides to take her home.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Wanis and his family try to find out the name of the girl that Ezzeldin brought, Wanis learns that her name is Magbora, and he sits with her for a long time to learn information about her. Abdullah finds a monkey and calls it Maimouna.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Maimouna runs away from Abdullah, he goes crazy and looks for her. Wanis tries to learn sign language in order to understand Magboura. Wanis takes the right of his daughter Jihad, after her friends accused her of forging her secondary school certificate.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wanis takes on a new job in a factory that manufactures fez. Ezzeldin confesses his romantic feelings to Magboura. Abdullah gets angry with Wanis after he sees money in his cupboard.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As a man named Som'aa tries to threaten Wanis as he goes to meet him in his office and tells him that he has been fired more than once from the directors of legal affairs of the company, Wanis calms him down and tells him that he will look into his matter.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Wanis wakes up from sleep to find that there is money stolen from his personal cupboard, which drives him crazy. He wakes everyone in the house and decides to search them but to no avail; everyone is suspicious of Magboura.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After Wanis and Maysa suspect Fou'ad, Wanis confronts him, then he is convinced that Fou'ad has nothing to do with the matter. Wanis discovers that Fou'ad has taken another wife.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Wanis decides to hide Magboura with his secretary, Mistika, especially since everyone accused her of the theft. Jihad tells her father that there is a suitor who wants to propose to her.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mo'taza accidentally discovers that her husband Hossam is the one who stole Wanis and his family to break down in tears and decides to tell Maysa, who tells Wanis. Hossam is confronted and scolded by Wanis. Mo'taza asks for a divorce from her husband.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Tharwat returns from travel and goes to Wanis' house. Four young men from the university propose to Jihad, Wanis' daughter, but he rejects all of them.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As Wanis asks the people of the street to collect money to clean their street, a number of men object. In the end, Wanis asks his kids to prepare to clean the street, whatever their decision is.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Tharwat tells Wanis that his money is back because of the stock market. As Sharaffudin and Hoda find two sacks containing a lot of money, they decide not to tell their father for the time being.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sharaffudin agrees with the electrician to light the street and asks him to tell everyone that this money is donated by him to the neighborhood. Wanis builds three rooms on the rooftop for literacy classes.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: As Abdul Jalil's brothers try to perform an operation for the daughter of a poor man, he tells them that he is still afraid because of the failure of the last operation, but the operation succeeds.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: As Khalil convinces Wanis to accept the job of legal affairs director at a food company, Wanis agrees after Khalil's insistence, after which he breaks off the engagement of Magboura and her fiancé.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Ezzeldin tries to get close to Magboura again after breaking off her engagement. Hossam asks Wanis to forgive him and go back to his wife again. The people of the neighborhood are surprised that the area got dirty again after they cleaned it up.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As Wanis decides to appoint men to guard the neighborhood after they discover that someone is trying to sabotage it at night, he appoints his son Ezzeldin and his friends. Wanis discovers that his friend Hamdi is the one who is behind the sabotaging.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ezzeldin goes to the restaurant where Magboura works, and tries to talk to her, but she gets angry with him. Abu Al-Fadl stands next to Anas Al-Wujud in her distress and illness.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As Wanis asks Farid, the owner of the company, Khalil and his friends to accept his dinner invitation, everyone flees and runs away when Wanis asks for food from the company, whereupon Khalil tells Wanis that the company's food is spoiled and exposed to radiation.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Wanis goes mad when he learns about the spoiled company's food and tries to collect all the spoiled food from the supermarket and butchers without people knowing, while everyone thinks Wanis is crazy.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: As Fou'ad asks to return to his wife's Harisa after she abandoned him, Hossam asks Wanis to mediate in order to return to his wife Mo'taza, and Wanis succeeds in bringing the married couples together in the end.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl prepares to travel with Anas Al-Wujud for treatment abroad, but he is surprised that his wife, Ferdous, has aborted her baby. Wanis informs the police about Farid and his partners.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Tharwat collapses after learning that his children is doing drugs and asks Wanis for advice. Wanis talks to his children. As Anas Al-Wujoud dies, Mo'taza, Harisa, Wanis, and his father inherit her.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Wanis contracts on a new apartment for himself and his family, after he learned that his old house was ordered to be removed. Sharaffudin succeeds and gets first place in his school.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: As Abla discovers that Abdullah has a talent for fashion design, she encourages and supports him. As Tharwat learns that Wanis needs new furniture, he furnishes his apartment, only for Wanis to be surprised and angered.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Wanis berates Fou'ad and Tharwat, after he learns that the furniture that Tharwat bought for him was a bribe. After Wanis tells Tharwat that he will return his full money to him, Wanis is shot by an unknown person.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Ezzeldin obtains from Khalil papers incriminating Farid and goes to the prosecution. The criminal who shot Wanis admits to his crime and tells them that Farid is the one who ordered him to do so. Abu Al-Fadl departs the life. The police arrest Farid.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Wanis recovers from a coma and discovers that becoming senile and seeing his children married was just a dream. Wanis receives the news of the death of Mama Zozo from his family.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After Wanis tries to convince Jihad not to transfer from the Faculty of Psychology to the Faculty of Commerce, Wanis discovers that Fou'ad told Hussein and Youssef that Wanis is not fluent in English so as to be excluded from traveling to London.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Farid is acquitted of the charge of killing Wanis. Jihad enrolls in the Faculty of Commerce. As the disputes between Abu Al-Fadl and Ferdous escalate, the latter begins to plan to end her life. Wanis begins to search for Tharwat.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The bond between Jihad and her university professor, Murad, is strengthened. Wanis succeeds in finding Tharwat in the heart of the desert and tries to convince him to partner up with him on the establishment of a school.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Murad persuades Jihad to return to the Faculty of Psychology. Wanis asks Tharwat to transfer the ownership of the school to him. Maysa's brother, Tahseen, returns after being abroad for 15 years.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Zeinat discovers that Khalil has hidden a large fortune from her after he was robbed. Maysa and Wanis mediate for Tahseen to get him engaged to Olfat.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wanis tells Maysa his story with the headmaster of his school and how he instilled many values ​​in him. After Wanis and Maysa think that Oshin is the maid, they discover that she is Ezzeldin's Japanese friend.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jihad takes care of Murad's kids while he is traveling. Wanis builds an apartment for Abdullah in the old house in the neighborhood to marry Abla. Wanis takes over the case of Islah and her son.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Olfat refuses to marry Tahseen because of her love for Metaw'. Ferdous suspects there is a relationship between Abu Al-Fadl and Oshin.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After the bank rejects Wanis' request for a loan to implement the school project, Tharwat plans to sell the school's land, but Wanis stands up to him. Abdul Jalil marries Hanan.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Murad confesses his love for Jihad. The neighbors suspect Abu Al-Fadl's repeated assault on Ferdous, but he denies it. Fou'ad discovers that Hossam is married to Sherine.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As Ferdous plots an accident to commit suicide and kill Abu Al-Fadl with her, she dies by drowning, upon which the police arrest Abu Al-Fadl on charges of killing her. The neighbors testify against Abu Al-Fadl. Abdullah and Abla postpone their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As Abu Al-Fadl's trial begins, Wanis defends his father in the case of Ferdous' murder, and he succeeds in proving his innocence due to insufficient evidence. Oshin leaves Wanis' home and returns to Japan.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Wanis discovers that there is a relationship between Jihad and her university professor, Murad. Wanis tries to prove that Ferdous committed suicide and the final innocence of his father. Fathia sets fire to Fawzi and Metaw's car.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: New evidence appears against Abu Al-Fadl after the prosecution discovers that there is an insurance policy from Ferdous in his name, but Wanis succeeds in proving that Abul-Fadl knows nothing about it. Tahseen tells Maysa that there is a relationship between Laila and Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Farid threatens to expose Khalil in the case of the spoiled food unless he gives him a million pounds. Wanis succeeds in proving once and for all the innocence of Abu Al-Fadl from the murder of Ferdous.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Khalil tells Farid about Wanis' project to establish a school with Tharwat. Inshirah tries to help Maysa by keeping Laila away from Wanis in her own way.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Khalil asks to withdraw from the school project and get his money to pay off his debt to Farid. Hossam is shocked when Maysa proposes to Sherine to get her married to Tahseen.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: As Inshirah eavesdrops on Wanis and Laila, a misunderstanding occurs, as she thinks they are planning to marry, so she tells Maysa. Jihad realizes the age difference between her and Murad and decides to stay away from him.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Ezzeldin travels to Japan to visit Oshin. Wanis continues in his plan to get Houria and Hosniya married to Ezzeldin and Sharaffudin, and Zakaria to Jihad.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ezzeldin returns from Japan. Abdullah marries Abla.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Wanis and Maysa evade Hoda's attempts to find out about the details of marriage and childbearing. The police arrest Fou'ad and accuse him of being involved in a smuggling operation. As Abu Al-Fadl crashes with his car into a person named Abu Al-Makarem, he discovers that he is his cousin.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Mo'taza discovers that Hossam is married to Sherine behind her back. Islah refuses Wanis' solutions by questioning her ex-husband's integrity so that Masry obtains the citizenship. The doctor tells Abdullah that Abla is pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Wanis and Abu Al-Fadl transform Mama Zozo's place into a house for maintaining kinship ties to shelter the homeless. Ezzeldin and his siblings discover Wanis' plan to wed them to Zakaria and his sisters, so they devise a plan to make him sell the apartments he bought so that they can build their own lives.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Farid threatens his mother and wife to kick them out of the house unless they break off their relationship with Wanis. Hossam divorces Mo'taza and Sherine. Hoda confesses to Wanis that his children, Zakaria and his sisters know his plan to marry them off.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Farid divorces his wife and kicks her out of the house. Wanis suffers from Abu Al-Makarem's repeated pretending to have wealth and doesn't believe the matter. Wanis deceives Jihad and Ezzeldin by telling them he will get them married to Tharwat's children.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Tahseen marries Islah. Wanis asks for Houria's hand for Ezzeldin and agrees to the engagement of Jihad to Zakaria. Wanis' dream collapses before the school opens after Farid submits documents proving he owns the land and a decision to knock down the school.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Wanis' children tell him about their rejection of the apartments he bought for them and about their wish to build their own lives. As Laila confesses her love to Wanis, he tells her that he only loves Maysa.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl sells the neighborhood house to Fathiya. Wanis and Tharwat stop the ruling on knocking down the school after they yielded it up to the Ministry of Education. Wanis and Maysa are convinced of their children's point of view by leaving them to build their lives.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Hossam threatens Mo'taza to obtain custody of their daughter if she got married. After Abu Al-Makarem leaves, Wanis discovers that they have wronged him and that he owns a fortune that he was trying to help them with.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Wanis works with Tharwat on a project to reclaim the desert. As Farid becomes helpless, he decides to repent and regrets what he did against Wanis for trying to kill him.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Wanis and his family begin the first steps of building and cultivating "The City of Dreams" in the desert.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After the failure of the desert cultivating project and building Dreamland, Wanis disappears, and his family stays in a hotel. Wanis tries to recover the money that was stolen from him.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wanis turns to his old friend, Baher, who has become a minister to solve the land problem. As Wanis refuses to use stolen money to get an apartment, the owner gives it to him for free for his honesty.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Wanis and his family move to the new apartment. Youssef discovers that Tharwat has bought a moving nightclub in Italy and wants to place it in the desert land, but he does not know that the state has seized the land.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Wanis discovers Khalil’s plan to divorce Abla from Abdullah to wed her to her wealthy cousin. Abu Al-Fadl meets his childhood friend, Gharib, and asks for his help to find work.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After their divorce, Hossam discovers that Sherine is pregnant. Maysa tries to convince Ezzeldin to back down from his decision to separate from Houria because he's unemployed.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Islah discovers Tahseen's betrayal with Effat. As Abu Al-Fadl works in a bowling alley, Gharib doesn't tell him that he's his boss. As Tharwat returns from Italy, he discovers that the land is gone.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Fou'ad takes advantage of Wanis to obtain financial aid. As Wanis informs the police about Tharwat's warehouse for nightclub equipment, the police find the warehouse empty.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Wanis stands up to Hoda's school because of their desire to cut down trees. Ezzeldin gets a job as a nutrition manager at a hotel. Magdy discovers that Sherine has a fatal disease.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Baher appoints Wanis as his deputy in the governorate. Gharib and Abu Al-Fadl discover that their neighbor Karamela is a famous actress. Abdullah's uncle hides from him that he has a great fortune.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wanis accepts the position of deputy governor out of his desire to solve the citizens' problems. Sherine gives birth to her child with Hossam. Khalil kicks Abla and Abdullah out of his home.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Khalil discovers that Wasim has no money and is schizophrenic. Abu Al-Fadl becomes angry at Gharib's desire to marry Karamela.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As Fathia dies, Hanan and Abdul Jalil inherit her wealth. As Abdullah's uncle, Shedid, dies, Abdullah and Abla find a lot of money in his bags. Wanis suffers because he feels that all those around him are exploiting him for his position.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl discovers that his manager in the bowling alley is Gharib. Khalil tries to take advantage of the great wealth that Abdullah has acquired. When Tharwat goes to return the money of the land to Wanis, his colleagues suspect that he's taking bribes.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: It's revealed that Sherine faked her illness and deceived Hossam to avenge herself and Mo'taza. Gharib and Abu Al-Fadl compete for Karamela's love. Sharafuddin asks Wanis to go with him to propose to Shahenda. Abdullah buys a tea factory.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: After Wanis helps the homeless children and transports them to Laila's shelter, the children escape. Hossam plots to remove Wanis from his position in the governorate and obtain the nightclub licenses.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Maysa tries to help Wanis in his work by establishing a charity home for the elderly. Sherine tells Wanis about Hossam's plan to remove him from his job. The children return to Laila's shelter.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: As Ezzeldin starts his movie career, he waits for the release of his film, only to discover that the director has deceived him. Karamela tells Gharib and Abu Al-Fadl that she's married to get them to stop their rivalry over her. Tharwat divorces Madiha.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: As Wanis visits Abdullah's factory, he finds out that the tea is spoiled. The police arrest Khalil. Sherif accuses Wanis in front of Baher of profiting from his position. Gharib and Abu Al-Fadl cause Karamela to be fired from the new movie.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Hossam gets around the law and obtains a license to open the nightclub. Baher refuses to accept Wanis' resignation from his position. Ezzeldin and Sharafuddin travel to Mexico.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As rumors spread in the press about a relationship between Karamela and Wanis, Karamela resorts to accepting to marry Gharib to discredit the rumors. Tharwat plans to sell the nightclub to Laila to turn it into an art theater.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Gharib confesses to Abu Al-Fadl and Karamela that he concealed from them that he's divorced with three children. Ezzeldin returns from Mexico with his brother after discovering that the work contract was on an illusion.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Maysa opens the Society for Kindness to Grandparents. Gharib discovers that his daughters have filed an interdiction case to get his fortune. Jihad and Zakaria get married.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sharafuddin becomes jealous because of Wa'el's desire to propose to Hosnyia. Wanis misses Jihad after her marriage. Wanis is shocked when he learns that his son Ezzeldin works in Hossam's nightclub.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Wanis refuses to help Ezzeldin by providing him with an apartment from the governorate in exchange for leaving his work in the nightclub. Islah forces Metaw' to divorce Olfat. The vice squad arrests Hossam in the nightclub.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Laila buys the nightclub to convert it into an art theater for the children of the shelter. As Khalil goes to Wanis to ask for Hosnyia's hand for Wa'el, Wanis refuses. Sharafuddin informs his father of his desire to drop out of medical school.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: As Zakaria agrees to Wa'el and Hosnyia's engagement, Wanis stands up to him. Ezzeldin marries Houria before they travel to work. Wanis and Maysa receive the news of Jihad's pregnancy.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Islah causes a wedge between Maysa and Wanis after telling her of his intention to marry Laila; Maysa leaves the house and stays with Jihad. Tharwat tries to exploit Wanis' position to demolish his factory by order from the governorate and obtain a large compensation.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Wanis refuses Tharwat's demands to demolish the textile factory. As Wanis ends up staying alone with Hoda after everyone abandons him, he goes to Maysa on their wedding anniversary to mend their relationship and bring her back home.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Maysa provides a job for Ezzeldin at the Society for Kindness to Grandparents. The party for the children's shelter is a success. As Wanis resigns from the position of Deputy Governor, he nominates Sherif to succeed him.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Wanis gets his job back at Youssef's company. Maysa and Wanis experience a new family feeling with the arrival of their grandchildren.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Wanis talks with his grandchildren about consumption and blind imitation, he takes China and its goods and products as an example of this. Abu Al-Fadl blames Wanis for reproaching his kids for not visiting to check on him.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wanis feels that his children are keeping him away from his grandchildren. Abu Al-Fadl thinks about opening a library. As Wanis interferes in the lives of his grandchildren and Hoda, his children tell him that he raised them wrong as they grew up and found those around them without morals.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Wanis refuses that Ezz deals with his manager by using hypocrisy. Abu Al-Fadl brings 2000 books to Wanis's apartment. Wanis advises Ezz, Sharaf, and Jihad to go to the cinema, and meets with grandchildren to know their problems.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Abdullah buys two stores from Youssef, he leases one of them to Abu Al-Fadl and the other to Khalil. Lamis tells Amina that she's worried that Wanis will marry another. Wanis causes problems when he uses his grandchildren's computers.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Hoda quits ballet. As Wanis's kids go to live with him, Sharaf turns his apartment into a clinic, as Ezz and Houria decide to travel to Japan, and Jihad asks Zakaria for a divorce. Lamis asks Wanis about a hundred thousand dollars that Maysa withdrew before her death.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sharaf is upset when Hosnyia sells the apartment. When Lamis accuses Wanis of taking the money from Maysa, he denies it. Wanis proves to Amina and Lamis that Youssef paid one hundred thousand dollars to his wife Sophia. Khalil tells Zeinat that he took the money from Maysa.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Youssef discovers that he got defrauded. Wanis talks with his grandchildren about the seriousness of suspicion. Khalil and Zeinat deny that they took money from Maysa. Lamis confronts Wanis with the paper Maysa left for Ezzat. Wanis doubts the source of his children's money .

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl tells Wanis that he finds money every day in the library. Wanis grieves because the source of his kids' money is from selling their conscience. Wanis knows that Khalil needs half a million for his heart operation. Abdul Khaleq proposes to Hoda. Lamis and Wanis find a check for Ezzat.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ezzat admits that he took the check from Maysa. As Abdullah and Abla give Khalil 350 thousand, they take from Wanis, Lamis, and Youssef 50 thousand each. The millionaire Gharib agrees to work in Abu Al-Fadl’s library. Wanis's children get rid of their ill-gotten money.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Lamis and Youssef agree to work together. Tharwat continues to check his election program for the People's Assembly. When Wanis talks with his grandchildren about creativity and democracy, they tell him about the need to have a role model first. Wanis asks Hoda to monitor Abdel Khaleq's behavior.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The State Security investigates Wanis and Sharaf because of Aman's publications on elections and freedom. Wanis asks Ahlam to teach him English. As Lamis gets closer to Wanis’s children and hears their problems, she asks them to consider her as their mother. Abu Al-Fadl goes to Gharib's company.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As Gharib continues to pretend to be poor, Abu Al-Fadl decides to sell the library. Bahaa lets Ezz get back to work in the hotel. Tharwat loses in the elections. Wanis, Lamis, and Hoda teach Abdul Khaleq a lesson when he criticizes Hoda's behaviors. Wanis decides not to let Hoda work after her graduation.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Zeinat tells Wanis that Khalil took the money to make a deal and not for a heart operation. Ahlam asks Wanis to file a divorce case against her husband. As Abu Al-Fadl gets angry after knowing about Gharib's lie, and that he was sending money to him, he eventually forgives him.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Abu Al-Fadl discovers that Gharib is married to Caramela. Wanis and Lamis try to bring Youssef and Amina closer together. Lamis thinks that Wanis wants to marry Ahlam. Wanis warns Tharwat not to write half of his wealth to Hady without the rest of his children.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Wanis's children try to keep their father busy so that he does not meet Ahlam. When Wanis discovers that the toys imported by Khalil may infect the children with viruses, he agrees to sell them to Abdullah and Abla. As Harisa and her son return from traveling, they stay with Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Ahlam rejoices after Wanis wins her divorce case. As Nader goes with his father to propose to Hoda, Tharwat comes to ask for Hoda's hand for his son Hady, who gifts her with a car and a necklace. Hossam promises Metaw' to know the whereabouts of Mo'taza from Harisa.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Hoda agrees to get engaged to Hady. Amina and Youssef agree to wed. Abu Al-Fadl travels with Gharib and Caramela to Greece. Wanis confronts his kids with their plan to keep him away from Ahlam. Wanis cancels his travel to Lebanon to stay with his grandchildren after his kids travel to Spain.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: As Harisa tells Hossam that Mo'taza is in Morocco, she takes 20 thousand from him, but she forgets the money in Abdullah's apartment. As Wanis notices that his grandchildren's addiction to mobiles and technology, he takes the devices from them. Nader decides to leave Wanis' office.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After his grandchildren go to Amina, Wanis goes there to bring them back. Wanis places a glass box so that if anyone makes mistakes, they put money in it. Wanis asks Tharwat not to rush into the marriage of Hady and Hoda. Nader confesses to Wanis his love for Hoda.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Lamis gets upset when her children ask her about the possibility of her marrying Wanis. Hoda tells Wanis that her car was inspected in a strange way. As Aman has a TV interview after his lecture at the university, he makes an appointment with the President of the Republic.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ahlam returns from Lebanon. As Hady uses Hoda to smuggle drugs behind her back, the police arrest him for smuggling drugs in cosmetics. Mo'taza agrees to meet Hossam and let him see his daughter Donia.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Wanis and Lamis notice that the grandchildren are influenced by the behavior of the adults. Wanis refuses to take Hady's case. Nader tells Wanis that he got engaged to his cousin. Wanis' grandchildren decide to donate to the residents of slum areas.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: As Wanis' kids return from Spain, they start to think about immigration. Amina asks the children to help Wanis marry Ahlam. As Wanis learns that Nader lied about his marriage to his cousin, Nader asks for Hoda's hand in marriage. Khalil sells his apartment for Youssef.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: In order to feel better about their decision to emigrate, Wanis' children get close to Ahlam so that Wanis would marry her. Khalil sells his apartment to Gharib. Wanis tries to help Hoda get to know Nader. Ahlam confesses her love for Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Wanis agrees with Ahlam to be just friends. Gharib, Youssef, and Tharwat discover that Khalil swindled them. Lamis tells Wanis' kids that she will stop them from immigrating. Caramela asks for a divorce from Gharib. Lamis and Ahlam confront each other about their desire to marry Wanis.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Wanis talks with his grandchildren about belonging. When Caramela learns that Gharib is married to Buthaina and has a child with her, it turns out that Abu Al-Fadl is behind this prank. Nader confesses to Hoda his love. Lamis tells Wanis that she loves him.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Lamis reads to Wanis, his kids, Abu Al-Fadl, and Amina Maysa's letter before she died in which she asks her to marry Wanis. Gharib finds out about Abu Al-Fadl's prank about his marriage to Buthaina. Nader and Hoda get engaged. When Thawart gives Hoda Khalil's apartment, she gives it to Youssef and Gharib.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Wanis agrees that his children travel abroad on the condition that they go on a trip with him on Gharib's yacht. Wanis criticizes the teachers who give private lessons. As Hossam and Mo'taza reconcile, he confesses to Wanis that he's married to another. Wanis agrees with Lamis to be his wife's sister.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Wanis asks his children to buy some strange things for the trip to Greece. Lamis tells Amina that she's the sister of Wanis' wife only. As Amina asks Ahlam to come to the trip, Wanis asks Nader to overcome his fear and come as well. Nader finds Yusef, the grandson of La Palis.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: As Wanis gets angry when his kids sell their apartments to emigrate, he attempts to treat Nader from his sea phobia. Wanis objects to the school principal after Aman failed because of his opinions about politics. Wanis asks Walaa's principal to redo her test because she cheated.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Wanis' family's ship arrives on an island in Athens. As Wanis' children plan to immigrate, Wanis tries to teach them a lesson about home. When a group of travelers go missing, Wanis calls up a line to form and look for them. Wanis discovers that his ship has disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Zakaria wants Wanis to get them back home as quickly as possible. Wanis finds a message from Gharib that he took the ship and will return in two months. Wanis and Metaw' go looking for Youssef and Amina.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When Abu Al-Fadl reads about how the island is submerged in water for eight months every year, Wanis discovers that they have two months until the island is flooded, putting everyone's lives in danger.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Wanis discovers that the canteen has been robbed, he suspects that the island is inhabited. Armed people attack Wanis' camp but Wanis discovers that it's just a prank show. Wanis' family goes home.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wanis discovers that another lawyer is poaching his clients. He meets the lawyer, Shiraz, who is taking his clients and warns her to stop.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As the Parliamentary elections start, an enthusiastic Wanis discovers that his children don't care about it. He arranges a meeting for his buildings' residents to choose a president for the Homeowners Association.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wanis tries to convince his family of the elections' importance, only to discover that Sharafuddin isn't a registered voter. Wanis tells Shiraz that she has no principals. Abu Al-Fadl discovers that Wanis isn't a registered voter either.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Wanis receives a gift from Esmat and discovers that Shiraz is not Esmat's daughter. When Wanis meets Esmat's competitor, he grows to respect how principled he is and decides to help him win the election.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Esmat sets Wanis up and Shiraz tries to warn Wanis about Esmat's plans. Shiraz resents Wanis for awakening her conscience.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wanis listens to people's complaints about prices and the difficulty of life but when a TV channel interviews them, they thank the government. Jihad discovers that she might get fired.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Wanis discovers that Shakira is responsible for the chaos in the building. When he meets her, he discovers that she is a vulgar and uncivilized woman. Jihad decides to work as an ad model as Zakaria becomes a taxi driver.
